summary: The player smoothly completed all three rounds of Word Hunt and reached the end card in 20.7 seconds, but experienced an initial 3.5-second idle period and a slow 7.1-second time-to-first-success. On the end card, the call-to-action buttons were not visibly rendered, leaving the player with no clear next step.

items.title: End card CTA buttons are invisible
items.evidence: At t=20.7s on the end card, the 'Nice haul.' header and '$6.60' badge are visible, but the 'Play on Scrambly' and 'Play again' buttons are completely dark/unrendered, resulting in only 36% confidence that a first-time player knows what to do.
items.suggestion: Remove any delayed fade-in on the end card buttons and render 'Play on Scrambly' with a high-contrast primary button style immediately when the end card appears at t=20.7s.

items.title: Slow start with 3.5s initial idle
items.evidence: From t=0.0s to 3.5s there was no on-screen motion or input, and it took 7.1s from the first playable frame until an input visibly worked.
items.suggestion: Display an animated hand-swipe tutorial over the first target word ('SUN') on the 4x4 grid immediately at t=0.0s to prompt the player's first swipe.

items.title: 3.0s idle gap between Round 1 and Round 2
items.evidence: After clearing Round 1 at t=7.1s with the '+$1.00' banner, there was a 3.0-second period (t=8.0-11.0s) with no on-screen motion or input before Round 2 gameplay began.
items.suggestion: Shorten the 'Round cleared! +$1.00' banner duration and transition directly into the 5x5 Round 2 grid within 1.0 to 1.5 seconds.
